title: MAMA use-case ↔ `mama` domain linkage file
description: MAMA-side glue joining stable MAMA use-case IDs to upstream `mama` units, domains, and contracts. Carries identifiers and versions only — never a merged identity and never a score. ruleset_version must reference a supported upstream MAJOR (fail-closed otherwise).

ruleset_version.description: Upstream ruleset the linked artifacts were issued under. MAJOR 2 required (fail-closed).

ledger_schema.description: Ledger schema of the linked ledger file. Only 2 is linkable; schema 1 must be re-baselined first.

linked_at.description: ISO-8601 date the linkage was recorded.

note.description: Free text; e.g. 'contract displayed as issued; automation metrics tracked separately'.
